data.one_liner: Search Wikipedia and retrieve page data using Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A search tool written in Dart that queries Wikipedia, retrieves articles, and fetches full page data using a page ID. It provides structured data like titles, summaries, and links.
use_when: You need to integrate Wikipedia search capabilities into a Flutter application.
You want to fetch Wikipedia article summaries and details using page IDs.
avoid_when: You need an official, heavily maintained SDK directly from Wikimedia.
You require complex offline caching of Wikipedia database dumps.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic search and page summary retrieval
data.setup_notes: Add the package dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer building direct REST calls to the MediaWiki API yourself without relying on a wrapper.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust HTTP client with interceptors and advanced networking features to query the Wikipedia API.
